Name: Claude Code Usage
Description: Monitor your Claude Code subscription usage in real time. Shows the 5-hour rolling limit and the weekly limit (all models) directly on your Ulanzi Deck button, with color-coded thresholds and reset countdown. Credentials are read securely from the macOS Keychain — no API key required.

Localization.keychainInfo: This plugin reads usage from the Claude Code CLI credentials stored in your macOS Keychain.
Localization.tokenRefresh: The token refreshes automatically when it expires. Click the button to force a refresh.
